name: Great Himalayan National Park Conservation Area
description: Tucked into the western Himalayas of Himachal Pradesh, this park in the Kullu region climbs from forested river valleys at about 1,500 metres to glaciated peaks near 6,000 metres. Visitors find alpine meadows, twenty-five forest types and rare wildlife among the ridges. Its glaciers and snowmelt feed rivers that supply water to millions of people downstream.
